These notes are **unfinished intentionally**. We will build them with students as the course develops, especially after we rebuild salvaged computers, install Ubuntu, and begin contributing documentation from our own work.
:::

## Course path

0. **Getting to Know You**  
   Personal identity → group identity → visual identity → logo design.

1. **N.I.C.E. Design Process**  
   Needs & Necessities → Investigate & Inquire → Create & Communicate → Evaluate → repeat.

2. **Building Computers**  
   Identify components, rebuild salvaged computers, install Ubuntu, test the systems, and document what we learn.

3. **Logo Design & Animation**  
   Move from identity and visual language into logo development, iteration, motion, and animation.

4. **Website Design**  
   Bring writing, graphics, identity, layout, and technical skills together in a website.

The notes will grow from classroom work rather than being presented as a finished textbook.
:::
